data.name: Avijit
data.long_meaning: Avijit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Avijit' which means 'new' or 'fresh'. It is a name given to a child born in new circumstances, or to mark a new beginning in life. In Hindu mythology, Avijit is the name of the god of new beginnings and prosperity. He is believed to bestow good luck and fortune upon his devotees.

data.cultural_impact: The name Avijit holds deep cultural significance in Hinduism. It is often given to a newborn child as a symbol of a fresh start in life, and is believed to bring good luck and prosperity. This name reflects the ideology present in many aspects of Hinduism, where starting anew and embracing change is embraced and celebrated.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Avijit carries the power of renewal and transformation. It is believed that the deity Avijit bestows blessings of good fortune, abundance, and new beginnings upon his devotees. The name is a reminder that just as the universe is always renewing itself, so too can we renew ourselves and begin anew.
